reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: In a separately identified pass, started from the Dutch OER and independently recomputed the selected modules by exact code from the annual catalogue. Rechecked the restricted choices, Dutch language diagnostic, thesis gate and exact course content for methods, assessment and treatment. Then checked workbook evidence and term/prerequisite facts before reviewing the finished decision, alignment and reader selections.
findings: The Dutch OER adopted 28 May 2026 and the 2026–2027 Dutch guide agree on 60 plus 48 compulsory EC, 12 connected preminor EC, a 30 EC open semester and a 30 EC final pathway. Select Behaviour and the Brain and Cognition and Emotion by regulation order. The broad prevention pathway follows the prospectus framing, independent of UCR fit. Its required 24 EC includes the 12 EC thesis. The selected track’s third-year taught work is in English; open study is independent.

OER Article 9.1 requires all first-year components for the thesis, and research participation precedes recording Psychological Conversation Skills 1. Article 10.4 applies the Dutch diagnostic and remediation before the Introduction to Psychology grade. The English test in the shared guide grouping adds no obligation. Articles 11–12 regulate practical attendance, pathways and elective approval. Article 14 sets 42 EC for positive first-year advice. The exact Methods 2, Statistics 2, Measurement 2 and Low Intensity Treatments entries verify empirical team research, regression and ANOVA, psychometric validity and bias, and practiced psychological interventions respectively.

Both options contain 180 EC and remain distinct. Behavioral Economics fits term 3, Data Science fits term 4 before Machine Learning, and Ethics fits term 6. Clinical assessment, psychometrics, conversation skills and empirical research are treated as separate contributions. The 12 EC thesis remains unmatched; optional UCR research sits outside the 180 EC schedule.
